newsitem.title: SUDAN: Sudan says seeks better ties with Ethiopia.
newsitem.headline: Sudan says seeks better ties with Ethiopia.

text.p: Sudanese President Omar Hassan al-Bashir was quoted on Sunday as saying his country did not support groups opposed to the Ethiopian government and wanted to improve relations with its eastern neighbour.
"Sudan is keen to improve ties with Ethiopia," Bashir said in a message to Ethiopian Prime Minister Meles Zenawi, quoted by the official news agency SUNA.
Relations between Sudan and Ethiopia have been strained since gunmen tried in 1995 to kill Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak in Addis Ababa.

Egypt and Ethiopia accuse Sudan of harbouring the gunmen and have lobbied the United Nations to impose travel and diplomatic sanctions on Khartoum until it extradites the men. Sudan denies the charges.

SUNA quoted Bashir as saying his country was not trying to destablise Ethiopia and had expelled groups opposed to the Addis Ababa government. Bashir did not name the groups but political observers say he was referring to Oromo Moslem rebels.
